name: openIMSs
description: Comprehensive open-source IMS environment for 4G/5G/NR voice/video/data/RCS/IM service development. 40+ microservices including Open5GS, OpenSIPS IMS, srsRAN, UERANSIM, and monitoring.

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker-compose.yaml plus additional configs: nsa-deploy.yaml, sa-deploy.yaml, srsenb.yaml, srsgnb.yaml, nr-gnb.yaml, nr-ue.yaml. 40+ microservices including monitoring (Grafana, qryn, Coroot).

eval_notes: Unique IMS/VoLTE-focused environment. Includes monitoring stack (Grafana, Portainer). Good for voice/video service testing evals. Evolved from docker_open5gs with expanded IMS support. Full IMS + 4G/5G lab with monitoring stack (Grafana, qryn, Coroot). Built on docker_open5gs with OpenSIPS for IMS CSCF. Includes observability making it useful for evaluation metrics collection.
